title: Editing a role's Part Library & Inventory boxes saves and reopens with the same access
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location "Staging Heavy Duty". Logged in as (a) Admin in one browser; a second browser for the (b) user on custom role "QA PL Create&Edit" (View + Create & Edit, Delete unticked). Data: QAPL-T1.
custom_steps:
1. As (a) go to Administration → Roles & Permissions and open Edit Role for "QA PL Create&Edit".
  2. Tick Part Library & Inventory → Delete, Save, then reopen Edit Role.
  3. Sign in again as (b), open the ⋮ actions menu on /parts/inventory and open QAPL-T1.
  4. As (a) untick Delete, Save, then reopen Edit Role.
  5. Sign in again as (b), open the ⋮ actions menu and open QAPL-T1.
custom_expected:
1. The group reads "Part Library & Inventory" with View and Create & Edit ticked and Delete unticked; only the group and labels are renamed (SV-10825), no box is added or removed.
  2. The role saves; reopened, Delete is ticked and the other boxes are unchanged.
  3. ⋮ shows Cycle count, Deactivate parts and Export; the dialog has enabled Part Status radios, an enabled tracking switch and Delete Part.
  4. The role saves; reopened, Delete is unticked and View and Create & Edit are still ticked.
  5. ⋮ shows Cycle count and Export only; Part Status radios and the switch are disabled and there is no Delete Part.
